# wowMD

wowMD is a lightweight Chrome extension for reading long public GitHub Markdown pages.

Official site: https://wowmd.app/

## What wowMD does

- Adds a Better view entry point to complex public GitHub README and Markdown pages.
- Opens with an outline so readers can understand document structure first.
- Provides section folding, code rendering, table scrolling, and cleaner Markdown rendering.
- Offers a local full-screen reader for focused reading.
- Appears only when a page is complex enough to benefit from structured reading.

## Current scope

Supported:

- Public GitHub repository README pages.
- Public GitHub `.md` file pages.
- Public GitHub `.markdown` file pages.
- Right-side reader panel and local full-screen reader.

Not currently supported:

- Private repositories.
- Non-GitHub websites.
- GitHub Issues, Pull Requests, Wiki pages, or other GitHub surfaces.
- AI summaries, translation, cloud sync, accounts, or settings.

## Privacy

wowMD is privacy-first:

- No personal information collection.
- No document upload to third-party services.
- No AI or cloud analysis in the current beta.
- No Raw Markdown or GitHub API request before the user clicks Better view.
- Local reading remains available without an account.

## Status

Current version: Beta v0.1.0

Pricing: free during beta.
